title: City of Piedmont says a cyberattack has been contained and no personal information was compromised
date_note: The pages give no date for the attack; 25 November is the day the city's announcement was reported.
geo_basis: The pages name no state; the outlets are US local news, so country only, pin at the US centre
summary: The City of Piedmont announced that it experienced a cyberattack, which city leaders say has been contained. Officials say that at this point no customer financial or personal information was compromised, according to Cedar News. The investigation is ongoing and the city has released no other details. NewsRadio 1000 KTOK reports that documents from Monday's City Council meeting show officials are not aware of any earlier cybersecurity assessment, and that the city proposes hiring CHUGTECH for a security review.
plain: A city says it was hit by a cyberattack that it has contained, and that at this point no customer financial or personal information was compromised. The investigation is ongoing.
exec: A city government reports containing a cyberattack and, at this point, no personal data compromised, per officials; details are limited while the investigation continues.

validation.note: KOKH read; Cedar News carries the same report, so one publisher in effect. No city page read.

review.note: stronger than the source: added Cedar News qualifier at this point to no-personal-information claim; KOKH and Cedar read
